# Paper Shaders 0.0.82

Unmodified vanilla ES modules and their source maps, copied from the approved
local background and logo experiments. Only the shared mount/sizing utilities,
Dithering, Grain Gradient, Liquid Metal and Grain's embedded noise texture are
included. Runtime shader source and texture processing are provided by Paper.
